## Column Definition

```text
global_substep          0-based row number including NaN rows
valid_substep           1-based count of valid substeps; blank for invalid rows
frame                   Dataset frame_index
substep                 Substep index inside the frame: 0, 1, 2, or 3
frame_timestamp         Dataset frame timestamp
sim_time                MuJoCo sim_time captured before mj_step
wall_time               Wall time captured before mj_step
q                       robot.motor_pd_substep_q[joint]
q_des                   robot.motor_pd_substep_q_des[joint]
q_des_minus_q           Position error used by the PD term for this joint
q_des_delta_prev_valid  q_des change from previous valid substep
dq                      robot.motor_pd_substep_dq[joint]
torque                  robot.motor_pd_substep_torque[joint]
valid                   Whether q and q_des are finite
```
